description:
These terracotta strip tiles for kitchen walls are natural, unglazed terracotta in a multi list format: narrow clay strips laid together for backsplashes and kitchen feature walls.

## How they look
Multi list terracotta tiles give a wall of long, slim clay lines, a little like thin brick, with the warm clay colour running through each piece. Natural terracotta tends to vary slightly in tone from strip to strip, which keeps a wall from looking printed. Confirm the exact strip sizes in the mix before you plan the layout.

## Where they work
- **A backsplash** behind a counter or sink, once sealed.
- **A kitchen feature wall** or a dining-area wall next to an open kitchen.
- **Bar counters and café walls**, where natural terracotta kitchen tiles bring a warm, rustic feel.

Clay strip wall tiles look good laid in a running bond like brick, or stacked straight for a more modern line.

## Good to know
- Material: natural terracotta
- Format: multi list (strips)
- Category: kitchen wall terracotta tiles
- Sizes in the mix: confirm on enquiry

Unglazed clay is porous, so seal the tiles before grouting and reseal as your fixer advises, especially behind a hob where oil splashes. Clean with a mild, pH-neutral cleaner and avoid acid cleaners.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to see the colour range, then get a dated quote. Read our [terracotta kitchen wall ideas](/blog/terracotta-kitchen-wall-tiles-ideas-that-handle-heat-and-splashes), compare the [natural clay brick tiles](/products/natural-clay-bricks-kitchen-wall-tiles) or browse the [terracotta kitchen range](/categories/kitchen-wall-tiles-terracotta).

faqs.q: What is the price of terracotta strip tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Can terracotta strips be used behind a stove?
faqs.a: Yes, once sealed. Unglazed clay is porous, so a penetrating sealer helps keep oil and water from soaking in; wipe splashes promptly and reseal as your fixer advises.

faqs.q: Terracotta strips or gutka brick tiles: which should I choose?
faqs.a: Strips are slimmer and give a finer, more linear look. Gutka brick tiles are closer in proportion to real brick and read more rustic. Both are natural clay and need sealing in a kitchen.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Multi List Terracotta Kitchen" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
